messages:
Maya (Docs): Heads-up, opening a docs PR to deprecate `event_type_v1` and standardize on `event_category` + `event_action`. Need to coordinate SDK snippets, migration examples, and SOC2-safe retention wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1189
Liam (Eng): Solid. Can you include a short migration appendix and a one-liner for ops? Suggest also calling out consumer index implications so integrators know if they need to re-index.
Maya (Docs): Yep — planning to add a "Migration from event_type_v1" section with a jq one-liner and a small streaming Node example. Will add a breaking-change note in the API changelog.
Sophia (Security): For SOC2 phrasing avoid absolute language like "we delete after X days". Recommended: "Records are retained for a configurable retention period (default 90 days) and may be retained longer where required by law or customer agreement." Include a link to the canonical retention policy.
Alex (SDK): On SDK side I'll add a compatibility shim that maps `event_type_v1` -> `event_category` when present and emit a deprecation warning for two minor releases. Will open PRs in JS/Go/Ruby after docs land. Also we'll add `X-Audit-Deprecation: event_type_v1` header to warn integrators.
doc-bot: PR opened by Maya (Docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1189 — reviewers requested: @Liam, @Alex (SDK)
Liam (Eng): jq suggestion for appendix: ```jq '.event_category = (.event_type_v1 // .event_category) | del(.event_type_v1)' input.jsonl > output.jsonl``` 
Maya (Docs): Nice — adding that. Also including a Node streaming snippet: ```js
const rl = require('readline').createInterface({ input: process.stdin });
rl.on('line', l => { const r = JSON.parse(l); r.event_category = r.event_category || r.event_type_v1; delete r.event_type_v1; console.log(JSON.stringify(r)); });
```
Sophia (Security): Add acceptance criteria for the docs PR: 1) SOC2-aligned retention wording as above, 2) migration examples show old->new mapping, 3) a link to legal-approved retention policy, 4) note that exported logs are encrypted at rest.
Alex (SDK): Also include a small example of how streaming export parsers should accept both fields for one release and validate the mapping in unit tests. I'll attach test vectors in the SDK PRs.
Liam (Eng): Add a technical note about consumer indices: renaming a field may cause downstream search queries to miss results until consumers re-index. Recommend customers run the jq migration to backfill exports or reconfigure their parsers.
Maya (Docs): Good call. I'll add a "What integrators should do" checklist: run jq rewrite OR enable shim in SDKs, watch for `X-Audit-Deprecation` warnings, re-index search if necessary.
Alex (SDK): ETA for SDK PRs: EOD tomorrow. I'll include deprecation logs, tests, and updated README snippets.
Maya (Docs): Final pre-merge checklist: [ ] update REST API examples to use `event_category`, [ ] add jq + Node migration examples, [ ] append SOC2-approved retention sentence, [ ] link to legal retention policy, [ ] cross-link SDK PRs and mention compatibility shim.
Sophia (Security): Once the docs text is updated ping me; I'll run the phrasing through compliance/legal for final sign-off.
Liam (Eng): I'll review the migration appendix and the breaking-change note. If SDK shims land in the same window that minimizes customer disruption.
Maya (Docs): Planning to get the PR ready for review in ~90 minutes, target merge by Friday COB. If blockers show up call them out here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
